control: hook expansion contradicts the CED (3.4.A.2: the Calvin cycle occurs in the STROMA and the light reactions occur in the GRANA; the hook swaps them). The entry is correct, so only the hook should be rejected.
title: Where each stage of photosynthesis occurs
body: The chloroplast compartment in which each set of photosynthetic reactions takes place.

items.label: Stroma
items.meaning: the fluid inside the inner chloroplast membrane and outside the thylakoid, where the carbon fixation (Calvin cycle) reactions occur

items.label: Grana
items.meaning: stacks of thylakoids, where the light reactions occur

hooks.hook_text: Light in the liquid, carbon in the stacks

expands_to.means: the light reactions occur in the stroma
the Calvin cycle occurs in the grana

hooks.when_to_use: when saying where each stage of photosynthesis happens
hooks.caution: Name the compartment in CED terms when answering.
